notes.title: Minor touch up to menus and ui to make the game feel more retro and less boring
notes.content: General overhaul to the UI to make things look better and fit the vibe of the newly commissioned store art.

notes.title: Fixing updating levels to the workshop
notes.content:
I finally figured out the issue with updating levels. You can now update levels by uploading an item you have already uploaded. 

Also if you try to play a level you have already downloaded, but has since been updated, it will download the level again.

Thanks for your patients.

Be creative to your hearts content!

notes.title: Updates to Steam Workshop Implementation
notes.content:
An issue was found where navigating the steam workshop menus were not always functioning as intended.

Added a method for deleting items if you want to remove duplicates or old iterations of levels.

Updating existing items is still an issue I am looking into, so the delete method is a temporary stop gap until I can figure out why updating existing items always seems to fail.
